text.en: Arabella, Fracture, Fracture Amplication

body.en:
Arabella's gimmick is the DoT Fracture
Fracture is 40% Dmg per stack, Max 30 = 1200% Max
Fracture whenever activated, gets cut in half and rounded down
Example:
30 -> 15 -> 7 -> 3 -> 1 -> 0
Fracture can be buffed by additive and multiplicative NONE CARD effects eg: Moral, Sever Ties, Observer's Pleasure
Fracture can also Crit
Fracture Amplification:
Fracture Amplification is very very important on Arabella
It changes Fracture Activate Math heavily
When Fracture is Activated, after Activation Frac Amp will refund 1/2 Fracture
1 generally, 2 if the enemy is solo
Example Math: if enemy isnt alone
4>2>3>1>2>1>2 etc
4 Frac Activate, Total Frac = 11 = 440%
If Enemy is Alone
4>2>4>2>4>2>4 etc
4 Frac Activate, Total Frac = 16 = 640%
Without Fracture Activate
4>2=2>1=1>0=0
3 Frac Activate, Total Frac = 7 = 280%
Fracture Amplification Example extended

Example Math:
If enemy isnt solo
30>15>16>8>9>4>5>2>3>1>2>1>2>1>2>1>2>1>2 etc
Total Activates 10, Fracture Stacks Total = 73 x 40% = 2920%
If enemy is solo
30>15>17>8>10>5>7>3>5>2>4>2>4>2>4>2>4>2>4 etc
Total Activates 10, Fracture Stacks Total = 89 x 40% = 3560%
